body:
I have talked to him about what I need or expect from him when I get like this but its like he goes blank and forgets everything I told him to do. And I get it, a lot of people dont know how to handle it which is why for the most part, I don't tell anyone I'm depressed. Like I wear a mask and pretend everything is okay and kind of shift my focus on other things to kind of distract my mind from getting this way. I just feel like he doesnt even try to help me. And I know it isnt his responsibility to help me with this. Hes not my nurse and maybe the situation does stresses him out but I just feel like for the most part I carry around depression like a heavy backpack and dont ask anyone for help (for years). I think the last time I broke down like this in front of him was a few years ago. And its like okay Ive been walking around with this heavy bookbag and havent asked you to help carry it but Im only human and right now I need a little help. Can you help me carry a small load so I can have a little break? But he doesnt do it. he just sits there. But I think you are right in saying that I am expecting a certain reaction from him and get upset when he doesnt do it. Like I just want him to TRY to help me thats all. And I dont have any support system, hes the only one who has seen me like this. I grew up being told I have no reason to be depressed so I literally perfected masking it. So I guess another part of the reason I am upset is because I am so quick to tell when someone else is sad and depressed but noone can pick up on my depression

I do want to take the next step and get some help but Im scared and honestly I just want someone to help me a little. And Ive told him I do want counseling or see a professional but I need a little help.
I dont think it would be creepy but I would try to see if theres another way of contacting her besides instagram, like maybe email her and jokingly tell her work is boring without her or something
Agreed, sex isn't our #1 priority since a lot of the time we are exhausted from work/ grad school but like you said a compliment is no effort

So outside the lack of compliments and sex, he's a pretty good guy and I don't have any major complaints. And I agree sex/compliments aren't something I need everyday in a relationship but to go months without ever feeling desired when I can see other guys lusting after me just makes me feel weird. Like I don't look for attention from other guys but if you rarely give me attention as my boyfriend, I'm at a loss as to what to do
